# PsycheAI

> A free personality reading from your own Instagram, with no questionnaire: a Psyche Card (the character you are most like, MBTI, Big Five, values, interests and love languages) and a Psyche Report (attachment style, career strengths, blind spots and more).
>
> The main way in is Meta Muse: paste "Install psycheai.io/skill and generate my Psyche" into Muse. Muse reads your Instagram on your own account, de-identified first, and writes your card and report there, in about 5 minutes. It is free, with no sign-up, and none of your data is sent to PsycheAI; only if you choose Psyche Sync are your card's few lines, motivation scores and daily rhythm (when in the day you post and message) shared.
>
> Without Muse, the website reads your Instagram data download or two or three WhatsApp chat exports in your browser, makes a short de-identified summary you review, and Google Vertex AI (Gemini, on Google Cloud's enterprise tier) writes the card. There, your first Psyche Card and Psyche Report are free; re-runs are US$5. Psyche Sync compares two people's cards for free. PsycheAI keeps no copy of your data or report.

Every page below is also plain Markdown at the same address with .md on the end.

## Start here
- [PsycheAI](https://psycheai.io/): make your free Psyche Card
- [PsycheAI in Muse](https://psycheai.io/skill): the Muse skill, what it reads and what it shares
- [FAQ](https://psycheai.io/faq.md): privacy, pricing and how it works
- [Sample report](https://psycheai.io/sample-report.md): what a reading looks like
- [Download your Instagram data](https://psycheai.io/download-instagram-data.md): the steps, in JSON format
